title: Grey four-fingered beings with a wand, telepathic instruction to comply
summary: Charlie Foltz tells of Grey four-fingered beings with a wand, telepathic instruction to comply, about August 1976 at Allagash Waterway, Maine, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I was told not to resist, not to fight. I wasn't in any danger. Just comply and everything will be all right.

plain: A man named Charlie Foltz says that in August 1976, on a trip to the Allagash Waterway, a remote river area in Maine, he was taken by grey beings with four fingers who carried a wand. He tells podcast host Jesse Michels that they told him through his mind not to resist or fight, that he was in no danger, and that everything would be all right if he complied. The event is the subject of a book, The Allagash Abductions, and if true it would be a firsthand account of being taken by nonhuman beings.
